summary_1line: Bhishma begins a tale illustrating the merit of protecting supplicants, introducing a cruel fowler caught in a storm who captures a helpless she‑pigeon.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a raging forest storm with lightning splitting dark clouds, a shivering fowler discovers a cold-stiffened she-pigeon on the flooded ground and traps her in a cage.
The sinister bird-catcher, black as a raven with bloody eyes, wanders the deep forest carrying nets and dead birds slung at his side.
